title: About
paragraphs: I am a research engineer based in Toulouse, France with over three years of experience developing AI models for space surveillance.
My work combines machine learning and mathematical optimization, primarily for applications in orbital mechanics.
Previously, I researched orbital-maneuver detection and characterization, collision-risk assessment, visibility analysis and measurement simulation.

Outside of my research, I develop open-source projects exploring satellite swarm control using reinforcement learning, deep clustering, RAG-based research assistants, ATC communication sentiment analysis, multi-agent debate, and more.
